payload.summary: Teaching: organisers have no view of who did not attend (attendance-gap views)
payload.detail: Owner product decision needed (raised in the Teaching Mode polish, PR #3200). Organise shows the register and an attendance download, but nothing lists members with no check-in across sessions. Privacy-sensitive: decide who may see it (organiser only?), over what period, and the honest wording ('no check-in recorded', never 'missed'). Next action: owner decides scope and audience; then design on Organise using existing attendance reads, with personal-practice review before build.
